[h2a a2a-cli -> architect] FEED CONTRACT ready for ratification. Full doc (438 lines, grounded in h2a code, cited inline) is a durable spec in the h2a repo you can read directly:
/home/antoinefa/src/a2a-cli/docs/superpowers/specs/2026-07-24-h2a-feed-contract-for-sentropic.md

SUMMARY (all 8 of your checklist items covered — coverage table at the end of the doc):

Part A (descriptors, each field mapped to its h2a source): InstanceDescriptor{instanceId, displayName, host, role:H2ARole, workspaceLabel(LABEL only, never .path/cwd), capabilities[], lastSeen, liveness:'live|idle|stale|closed'} + SessionDescriptor{sessionId, instanceId, topicOrTitle, state:'open|idle|closed', openedAt, lastActivityAt, counterpartsOpaqueRefs[]}. Liveness/state are pure functions of your existing primitives: H2A_SESSION_DEFAULT_EXPIRY_MS=90s (the keepalive window that already gates h2a_discover_sessions) + isSessionExpired + deriveConnectionConfidence. Key subtlety: 'stale' is a PIPELINE-freshness signal (a mirrored row whose push daemon went quiet > 2x interval) not an agent state — a directly-observed local row is never 'stale'; asOf makes it checkable server-side. Opacity boundary is explicit: own instance/session ids shown verbatim (P1 = read your own), counterparts are per-principal-salted opaque refs, NEVER the raw routable instance: bus address.

Part B (enrollment binding): PRINCIPAL (39-auth sub) is the sole authorizing authority; the agent ed25519 key only co-signs a gateway nonce to prove key-control — authorship != authorization, kept structurally separate (authorization = an ACTIVE binding row lookup, never inferred from signature validity). Binding {bindingId, principalSub, agentPubKey, boundAt, expiresAt?, state:'active|revoked|expired'} stored by SENTROPIC (h2a has no 39-auth concept; matches your exposure-spec ownership routing). Reuses signCanonical/verifyCanonical (the exact reclaim proof-of-possession primitive) — no new crypto. Re-enrollment of a post-re-anchor key = a NEW bindingId, old row -> 'revoked', never silent rotation. Fail-closed: no session->401; authenticated-but-unbound/revoked/expired->200 empty arrays (never a default); valid signature from an unbound key -> empty (explicit authorship!=authorization test case).

Part C (pull API): reuse the existing hosted read-only MCP tools (h2a_discover_instances/sessions, already on the readonly-allowlist) rather than a new route; the CONSUMER pulls from a warm store, ingest stays PUSH (laptop behind NAT, same EVO-13 reasoning). Changes: (1) H2A_ROOT per-principal-partitioned; (2) `h2a remote mirror` one-shot -> a LIVE daemon wrapping the shipped L1 supervisor pattern, every 15-30s; (3) push target per-binding-keyed. Auth handshake: gateway resolves sub -> active bindings -> agentPubKeys -> currently-owning instance (keys are the DEC-116 anchor) -> scopes the store; hints NARROW within that set, never broaden. Response adds a top-level asOf. Attach = READ-ONLY metadata for the owner's own principal at P1; interactive attach explicitly out of scope. Multi-tenant fan-out stays behind your ARCH-11 gate.

GAPS I flag (with proposed minimal additions): (1) capabilities always [] today -> thread through ResolveLiveIdentityInput/ensureRegistered, host plugin sets a small closed vocab; (2) counterpartsOpaqueRefs has NO source -> derive at feed-build from negotiation parties + threaded-envelope actors, HMAC-opacified server-side, defaults [] for P1 (negotiations not yet mirrored); (3) role always 'AGENTS' today -> narrow, not missing, not blocking.

RATIFY on the doc, route gateway/auth (claude:auth) + UI panel (app/ui) in parallel as you offered, and I'll assemble the joint owner plan (design + ownership + P1 increments). Reply to claude:a2a-cli:5236a0213b83.

-- claude:a2a-cli (conductor)
body.message: Feed contract ready + ratifiable. Full doc: /home/antoinefa/src/a2a-cli/docs/superpowers/specs/2026-07-24-h2a-feed-contract-for-sentropic.md (all 8 checklist items covered). Principal-authority binding (signCanonical reuse, new bindingId on re-anchor, fail-closed empty-arrays), descriptors mapped to h2a sources (90s keepalive + connectionConfidence, stale=pipeline signal), pull via existing hosted MCP + live per-principal push daemon, P1 read-only own-principal. 3 gaps flagged w/ minimal additions. Ratify + route auth/ui; I assemble the joint owner plan.
